description: This file defines the AuthorRepository interface for managing Author entities in a Spring Data JPA context. It extends JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations and includes method declarations for finding by ID, finding all authors, and deleting authors, with specific entity graph annotations to optimize fetch strategies.

classes.name: AuthorRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Author entities providing CRUD operations with custom fetch strategies.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an Author by ID with a specified entity graph for fetch optimization.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns all Author entities with a specified entity graph for fetch optimization.
